executive_summary.text: Cost year 2023: the home reported $441,469 in management fees (cost report line m12).
Cost year 2023: nursing pool (agency) cost reported was $354,724.
Cost year 2023: direct care cost was $153.3 per resident day (46.5% of expenses); Connecticut median $167.62.
Cost year 2023: nursing home operating margin was -4.1% (Connecticut median -3.1%).
